segments.nethackrc:
OPTIONS=name:Petra,role:Ranger,race:human,gender:female,align:neutral
OPTIONS=playmode:debug,!tutorial,!legacy,!autopickup,time,disclose:yi ya yv yg yc yo,menucolors
MSGTYPE=stop "You.*hit"
MSGTYPE=norep "(a|b)*\1"
AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION=">potion(.+| ?)e{2,3}"
MSGTYPE=stop "(\w$)*[[:punct:]]\.*[a-cx-z]*"
AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION="^[[:space:]]\1*$"
MSGTYPE=norep "of{3}"
MSGTYPE=hide "( potion|is?)gold*((\w.+|(hit[a-z]?).){2})((\.?)+)*"
MENUCOLOR="[[:upper:]]+"=red
MENUCOLOR="([[.a.]]gold{0,4})?see"=green
